title: Vivian Jones - What you Gonna Do / Dub

I just realize you're not worth it
I'm not gonna have no more sleepless nights
Tell me, what you gonna say
Are you gonna cry? Cry your eyes out, baby
What's he gonna do? Tell me
When I walk out that door
For all the wrongs you've done to me, girl
What's y'all, what's y'all gonna do when I say bye-bye?
When I say bye-bye, yeah, yeah
I'm leaving you over, baby, leaving you behind, yeah
